desc: 钴蓝硬边平涂色块配冷钢白台面的手撕小面包详情套图
name: 钴蓝平涂几何螺旋面包款

shots.intent: 首屏用钴蓝硬边色块与冷钢白场承接点击，一眼给出产品与主标题位。
shots.textZone: left 30% column on the cobalt block: one headline plus one short sub-line

shots.intent: 把源页三枚圆章卖点条改成三个空白方角图章位，一秒承接核心主张但不做成分暗示。
shots.textZone: top cobalt band holds three blank badge outlines; one headline in the band below it

shots.intent: 用同框两态的干硬掉渣与松软撕口对照放大日常痛点，只讲质地不讲数据。
shots.textZone: one blank label card under each panel, left and right short labels

shots.intent: 以可实拍验证的气孔与撕拉丝组织承担质地证明，替代源页的功效文字。
把源页高角度桌面场景改到冷钢白台面，让买家代入真实早餐一刻。
沿用源页左图右文双栏结构，把口感描述全部留给占位符。
shots.textZone: right 35% column: one headline plus one short label

shots.intent: 把源页两块灰空面板与中央圆章改成同基线侧剖质地对照，证明点落在可见差异上。
shots.textZone: one short label inside each blank card under the panels

shots.intent: 把源页三格空白原料带与两列参数表合并成一屏纯空白卡位，规格取值一律留位。
shots.textZone: six blank value slots on the card, two shown and the rest left empty

shots.intent: 把源页多顶面配色与三步错落带收成一行三件平铺，让买家自行挑选。
shots.textZone: top band headline plus three blank label cards under the pieces

shots.intent: 以可实拍的独立包装与撕口结构加两枚空白凭证框消解风险，不写任何资质与期限。
用一枚空白方角行动卡收口，替代源页会员角标与二维码的促销引导。
shots.textZone: upper right band: one short closing line rendered inside the blank action card

style.backgroundSystem: hard-edged flat cobalt blocks #2B5EA6 laid over one seamless cool steel-white field #E0E5EB, exactly one straight hairline divider or one vertical cobalt band per screen, one low matte riser block for height; no plaster sweep, no tile plane, no paper or cloth ground, no gradient, no horizon, no scenery, no dark studio falloff
style.iconSystem: square-cornered blank cards, hairline double-rule boxes and one small blank square seal frame only, drawn at one uniform 1.5px weight in cobalt #2B5EA6 or chartreuse #B7C93F; no circles, no discs, no medallion badges, no cereal, wheat, grain, leaf, flame, shield, cross, scale, tick, arrow, body or check-mark glyphs
style.lightingSystem: even cool daylight-balanced key at about 6000K from a large front soft source with a weak white bounce card on the shadow side; soft short contact shadows only, no hard specular, no warm amber or tungsten cast, no sun patches, no window-blind stripes; texture screens use one soft skimming light from the right
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool graphic flat-block bakery-snack visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cobalt blue blocks #2B5EA6, cool steel-white ground #E0E5EB, one chartreuse accent #B7C93F and deep ink-blue lettering #232A31, with no hue outside these four and no warm amber grade anywhere; even cool daylight-balanced key at about 6000K from a large front soft source with a weak white bounce card on the shadow side, soft short contact shadows only, texture screens lit by one soft skimming light from the right; backgrounds limited to hard-edged flat cobalt geometry over a seamless steel-white field with one straight hairline divider or one vertical cobalt band per screen, surfaces limited to a fine-grain matte steel-white table plane, matte lacquered board planes and one low matte riser block, with no wood, no bamboo, no rattan, no jute, no linen, no gingham, no rice paper and no marble chip; one modern geometric sans-serif used only for headline and label placeholders, lettering in deep ink-blue #232A31 on steel-white and steel-white inside solid cobalt, headline 28-48pt, one sub-line 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, one weight per screen, maximum two copy lines; graphic components restricted to square-cornered blank cards, hairline double-rule boxes and one small blank square seal frame at one uniform 1.5px weight, with no circles, no badge discs and no cereal, wheat, leaf, scale, tick, arrow or body iconography; the pieces hold one fixed size, surface sheen and clean torn face on every screen and are never scaled up or stacked into a tower; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no hue outside #2B5EA6 #E0E5EB #B7C93F #232A31 and no warm amber or candlelit food grade on any screen
no mixed fonts, no calligraphy and no pinyin letter rows
no wood, bamboo, rattan, jute, linen, gingham or rice-paper surface in any screen
no cereal kernels, flour clouds, scales, tick marks, arrows or ratio charts anywhere
no gradient background, no coloured drop shadow, no floating piece without a contact shadow
no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting between panels, no mismatched icon styles
style.presentationRules: the pieces keep one fixed size, one surface sheen and one clean torn face across the whole set, shown whole and fully inside the frame or torn once; never scaled up to giant size, never stacked into a tower; copy always occupies a named side band, never sits on top of the product; no ingredient, process, dosage or comparison-measure imagery anywhere
style.surfaceSystem: fine-grain matte steel-white table plane #E0E5EB and matte lacquered board planes, one low cobalt riser block #2B5EA6, square-cornered steel-white cards #E0E5EB with a hairline rule in deep ink-blue #232A31; no wood, no bamboo, no rattan, no jute, no linen, no gingham check, no rice paper, no marble chip
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif used only for headline and label placeholders; lettering in deep ink-blue #232A31 on the steel-white fields and steel-white #E0E5EB inside solid cobalt blocks #2B5EA6; headline 28-48pt, one sub-line 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, one weight per screen, maximum two copy lines per screen, no calligraphy, no brush script, no serif display, no pinyin letter rows
